title: दैनिक अग्नि हवन
description: Ghar mein positive energy lane ke liye ek chota havan. Yeh nakaratmak urja ko nasht karta hai aur vatavaran ko shuddh karta hai.
itemsNeeded: Havan Kund ya mitti ka kasora
steps: Subah snaan karke saaf kapde pehne aur purva (East) disha ki or mukh karke baithein.
Havan kund ko saaf karke usme aam ki lakdi aur kapur rakhein.
Kapur ko jalayein aur Agni Dev ka aavahan karein: 'Om Agnaye Namah'.
Ghee aur samagri milakar havan samagri tayar karein.
Gayatri Mantra ya Mahamrityunjaya Mantra bolte hue 11 ya 21 baar ahuti dein. 'Swaha' bolkar ahuti chodein.
Ant mein kshama prarthana karein aur shanti paath karein. Havan ki bhabhooti (ash) ko mathe par lagayein.
expectedBenefit: Vatavaran ki shuddhi, man ki shanti aur ghar mein sakaratmak urja ka sanchar.
precautions: Aag ke paas savdhani bartein.
Bacho ko dur rakhein.
Havan kund ko turant na chuyein, thanda hone dein.

title: नज़र उतारना
description: Buri nazar aur nakaratmak urja se bachav ke liye saral gharelu upay. Bachon aur badon dono ke liye asardar hai.
itemsNeeded: Fitkari (Alum) ya Lal Mirch (Dry Red Chillies) - 3 se 7
steps: Jisko nazar lagi ho use asan par bithayein ya khada karein.
Apne daayein haath (right hand) mein fitkari, thoda namak aur lal mirch lein.
Vyakti ke sir se lekar paon tak, ghadi ki disha (clockwise) mein 7 baar utaarein.
Utaarte samay Hanuman ji ya apne Isht Dev ka dhyan karein aur man mein prarthana karein ki buri nazar door ho.
Utaarne ke baad in samagri ko chulhe (gas) ya kande ki aag mein jala dein ya ghar se bahar fenk dein.
Jab lal mirch jalegi to jhanjh aayegi, agar jhanjh na aaye to samajh lein nazar tez thi. Fir jalne ke baad vyakti ko paani pilayein.
bestTime: Shaam (Evening) ya Raat, visheshkar Mangalwar ya Shanिवार ko
expectedBenefit: Buri nazar ka prabhav kam hona, chidchidapan door hona.
precautions: Jalate samay dhuein se bachein.
Utaari hui samagri ko wapas ghar mein na layein.

title: हनुमान चालीसा पाठ
description: Sankat mochan Hanuman ji ki kripa prapt karne aur bhay, rog, shok door karne ka saral aur shaktishali upay. Har prakar ki badhaon se raksha.
steps: Snaan karke swachh vastra pehne aur lal aasan par baithein.
Samne Hanuman ji ki murti ya chitra rakhein.
Diya jalayein aur dhoop-agarbatti karein. Hanuman ji ko lal pushp arpit karein.
Pehle Shri Ram ji ka dhyan karein, fir Hanuman ji ka aavahan karein.
Bhakti bhav se Hanuman Chalisa ka paath karein (1, 3, 7 ya 11 baar).
Paath poora hone par prasad chadayein aur aarti karein. Prasad parivar mein baantein.
bestTime: Subah ya Shaam, visheshkar Mangalwar aur Shanivar
expectedBenefit: Bhay aur sankat se mukti, aatmavishwas mein vriddhi, shatruon par vijay.
precautions: Paath ke dauran dhyan na bhatkayein.
Maans-madira ka sevan na karein.
shastraReference: Tulsi Das Rachit Ramcharitmanas aur Chalisa

title: शुक्रवार लक्ष्मी पूजा
description: Mata Lakshmi ki kripa aur ghar mein dhan-samriddhi lane ke liye Shukrawar ki vishesh puja. Aarthik sthiti majboot karne mein sahayak.
itemsNeeded: Mata Lakshmi ki murti ya chitra
Kheer ya bataashe prasad ke liye
steps: Shukrawar (Friday) sham ko ghar ko saf suthra karein.
Ek chowki par laal kapda bichakar Mata Lakshmi ki pratima sthapit karein.
Ghee ka deepak jalayein, aur Mata ko kumkum ka tilak lagayein.
Kamal ka phool ya laal pushp Mata ko arpit karein aur akshat chadhayein.
Shri Suktam ka paath karein ya 'Om Shreem Mahalakshmiyei Namah' mantra ka 108 baar jaap karein.
Kheer ya mitha prasad chadayein, aarti karein aur prasad sabhi sadasyon ko baantein.
expectedBenefit: Dhan aur samriddhi ka aagaman, karz se mukti aur ghar mein barkat.
precautions: Ghar mein kalesh ya jhagda na karein.
Safai ka vishesh dhyan rakhein.

title: शनि उपाय
description: Shani Dev ke dushprabhav ko kam karne aur kashton se mukti paane ka aasan gharelu upay. Sade Sati aur Dhaiya mein vishesh labhdayak.
steps: Shanिवार ki sham ko snaan karke swachh kapde pehne.
Ek mitti ke diye mein sarson ka tel aur thode kale til daalein.
Diya jalakar ghar ke bahar pipal (Peepal) ke ped ke niche rakhein.
Shani Dev se prarthana karein: 'Om Sham Shanaischaraya Namah'.
Kutte (Dog), kauwe (Crow) ya garib vyakti ko kuch khila dein ya daan karein.
Ghar wapas aate samay piche mudkar na dekhein aur na hi raste mein kisi se baat karein.
expectedBenefit: Shani dosh se rahat, karyon mein aa rahi badhaon ka nivaaran, mansik shanti.
precautions: Ghar ke puja sthal (mandir) mein Shani Dev ki murti sthapit na karein.
Sarson ke tel ka sevan Shanivar ko kam karein.

title: तुलसी पूजा
description: Ghar mein pavitrata, shanti aur Bhagwan Vishnu ki kripa banaye rakhne ke liye niyamit Tulsi ji ki puja. Ghar ki nakaratmakta ko door karti hai.
steps: Subah uthkar, snaan ke baad swachh vastra dharan karein.
Tanbe ke lote mein shuddh jal lein aur usme thoda haldi ya kumkum milayein.
Tulsi ke paudhe ki jad mein jal arpit karein: 'Om Tulasyai Namah'.
Tulsi ji ko haldi/kumkum lagayein aur phool chadayein.
Sham ke samay Tulsi ke paas ek ghee ya tel ka diya jalayein.
Tulsi ke paudhe ki 3 parikrama (pradakshina) karein aur sukh-shanti ki prarthana karein.
expectedBenefit: Pavitrata, ghar mein shanti, swasthya labh aur bhagwan ki kripa.
precautions: Raviwar (Sunday) ko Tulsi na todein aur na jal chadayein.
Bina nahaaye Tulsi ko na chuyein.

title: गुग्गुल धूप
description: Ghar se har prakar ki nakaratmak urja, buri nazar aur sankramak kitanuon ko door karne ka asardar tarika.
steps: Sham ke samay, suryast ke baad, ghar ke mandir ke paas baith jayein.
Kande (cow dung cake) ko kapur ki madad se jalakar dahkayein (glowing ember banayein).
Dahakte kande ko ek mitti ya dhatu ke patra mein rakhein.
Us par thoda sa desi ghee dalein aur guggul ke chote tukde uspar rakhein.
Guggul se uthne wale dhuein (dhoop) ko pure ghar ke har kamre mein dikhayein.
Dhoop dikhate samay 'Om Hoom Hanumate Namah' ya koi shanti mantra ka jaap karein.
expectedBenefit: Ghar mein shanti, negative energy ka naash, aur mahol mein pavitrata.
precautions: Agar asthma ki problem ho toh dhuein se bachein.
Dhoop ke patra ko aag se bacha kar rakhein.

title: गंगाजल छिड़कना
description: Ghar aur vyakti ko shuddh aur pavitra karne ka sabse pracheen aur saral tarika. Vastu dosh aur ashuddhi ko door karta hai.
itemsNeeded: Kusha ghas ya Tulsi ke patte (Sprinkling ke liye)
steps: Subah ki puja ke baad tanbe ke lote mein thoda Gangajal lein.
Agar Gangajal kam ho to usme shuddh peene ka paani mila lein.
Kusha ghas ya Tulsi ke patte ko Gangajal mein duboyein.
Ghar ke mandir se shuru karke, pure ghar ke har kamre aur konon mein jal ka chidkav karein.
Chidkav karte samay 'Om Pavitro Apavitro Va...' ya 'Om Namah Shivaya' ka jaap karein.
Ghar ke mukhya dwar (Main door) par vishesh roop se chidkav karein.
expectedBenefit: Vatavaran ki shuddhi, nakaratmakta ka naash aur sakaratmak urja.
precautions: Toilet ya bathroom mein Gangajal na chhidkein.
Jute-chappal pehan kar chidkav na karein.

title: रुद्राक्ष माला महामृत्युंजय जाप
description: Swasthya, ayu vriddhi aur gambhir rogon se mukti ke liye Shiv ji ka sabse shaktishali mantra jaap.
itemsNeeded: Shiv ji ki murti ya chitra
steps: Subah jaldi uthkar snaan karein aur saaf kapde pehne.
Shiv ji ke samne asan bichakar Purva (East) ya Uttar (North) disha ki or mukh karke baithein.
Shiv ji ko jal chadhayein, dhoop-deep jalayein aur pranam karein.
Rudraksha ki mala apne daayein (right) haath ki madhyama (middle) aur anamika (ring) ungli par rakhein.
Anguthe (thumb) se mala p फेरते hue 1 mala (108 baar) Mahamrityunjaya Mantra ka jaap karein.
Jaap poora hone par shanti prarthana karein aur bhagwan se swasthya labh ki kamna karein.
expectedBenefit: Ayu vriddhi, rogon se ladne ki shakti, akaal mrityu se raksha.
precautions: Mala ko zameen par na rakhein.
Tarjani (index finger) se mala ka sparsh na karein.

title: बिल्व पत्र शिवलिंग पूजा
description: Shiv ji ko prasann karne aur sabhi manokamnayein poorn karne ka ati saral aur punya faldayi upay.
itemsNeeded: Bilva Patra (3 leaves joined together) - at least 3, 5, or 11
steps: Subah snaan karke pavitra man se puja sthal par baithein.
Shivling par sabse pehle shuddh jal se abhishek karein: 'Om Namah Shivaya' bolte hue.
Shivling par chandan ka lep lagayein aur akshat arpit karein.
Bilva patra ko dho lein, dhyan rakhein patte kate-fate na hon.
Bilva patra ki chikni satah (smooth side) par chandan se 'Om' likhein aur Shivling par ulta karke (chikna hissa niche) chadayein.
Haath jodkar Shiv ji se apni manokamna kahein aur dhyaan karein.
expectedBenefit: Manokamna poorti, paapon se mukti, aatmik shanti.
precautions: Bilva patra ko Chaturthi, Ashtami, Navami, Chaturdashi aur Amavasya ko na todein (pehle se tod kar rakh lein).
Tute hue chawal na chadayein.

title: सूर्य नमस्कार मंत्र के साथ
description: Sharirik aur mansik swasthya ke liye Surya Dev ki aradhana aur yog ka sanyojan. Urja aur tej badhane ka sarvottam tarika.
itemsNeeded: Khula sthaan jahan dhoop aati ho (Subah ki)
steps: Subah suryoday ke samay (Sunrise) uthein aur snaan karke yoga mat bichayein.
Surya Dev ki or (East) mukh karke khade ho jayein.
Pranamasana (Prayer pose) mein aayein aur man hi man Surya Dev ka smaran karein.
Har ek aasan ke sath Surya ke 12 mantron (jaise Om Mitraya Namah, Om Ravaye Namah) ka ucharan karein.
Saanse lene aur chhodne (inhale/exhale) ka rhythm banaye rakhein.
Kam se kam 6 se 12 set poore karein. Ant mein Shavasana mein letkar vishram karein.
expectedBenefit: Purna sharirik vyayam, immunity vriddhi, tej aur ojasvi vyaktitva.
precautions: Khali pet hi karein.
Kamar ya back pain ho to savdhani bartein ya doctor se puche.

title: गायत्री मंत्र जाप
description: Buddhi, vidya aur gyan ki vriddhi ke liye Gayatri Mata ki upasana. Vidyarthiyon (students) ke liye atyant labhdayak.
steps: Pratah kal jaldi uthkar snaan karein aur saaf vastra pehne.
Purva (East) ya Uttar (North) ki or mukh karke shanti se asan par baithein.
Aankhein band karein aur bhrukuti (between eyebrows) mein prakash ka dhyan karein.
Spasht ucharan ke sath Gayatri Mantra (Om Bhur Bhuva Swaha...) ka jaap karein.
Kam se kam 11, 21, ya 108 baar (1 mala) jaap karein.
Jaap ke baad 2 minute maun rehkar dhyan karein aur buddhi vikas ki prarthana karein.
expectedBenefit: Ekagrata (Concentration), smaran shakti (memory) mein vriddhi, man shanti.
precautions: Mantra ka ucharan shuddh (correct pronunciation) hona chahiye.
Ashaant mahol mein na karein.

title: नवग्रह शांति (सरल)
description: Naugrahon (Nine Planets) ke dushprabhav ko kam karne aur jivan mein santulan lane ka aasan nitya karm.
steps: Snaan ke pashchat, puja sthal par ek thali mein Navdhanya (9 anaj) rakhein, jo Navgraho ka prateek hain.
Ghee ka deepak jalayein aur Navgraho ko pranam karein.
Navgraha Beej Mantron ka (Om Suryaay Namah, Om Chandraay Namah...) 1-1 baar jaap karein ya Navgraha Stotram ka paath karein.
Har grah ke naam par ek phool ya akshat chadhayein.
Ant mein Surya ko arghya (jal) arpit karein aur sabhi graho se anukul hone ki prarthana karein.
Thali mein rakhe anaj ko agle din pakshiyon ko daal dein.
expectedBenefit: Grah dosh shanti, jivan mein aane wali akaran badhaon se chhutkara.
precautions: Navgraha mandal ki safai niyamit rakhein.
Sattvik bhojan ka palan karein.

title: पितृ तर्पण (सरल विधि)
description: Apne purvajo (ancestors) ko shanti pradan karne aur Pitru Dosh ko door karne ke liye ghar par hi tarpan ki saral vidhi.
steps: Subah jaldi uthkar snaan karein aur dakshin (South) disha ki or mukh karke baithein (Pitruon ki disha).
Tanbe ke lote mein jal, kale til, thoda doodh aur safed phool dalein.
Kusha ki angoothi (Pavitri) banakar anamika ungli mein pehne, ya kusha ko haath mein lein.
Dahine haath ki hatheli ke angoothe wale hisse (Pitru Tirtha) se jal niche chodein.
'Om Pitrubhyo Namah' ya apne pitruon ka naam lekar jal zameen par ya kisi bartan mein 3 baar arpit karein.
Tarpan ka jal baad mein kisi paudhe (Peepal ya Babool, par Tulsi nahi) ki jad mein daal dein.
bestTime: Subah (Amavasya ya Pitru Paksha mein vishesh)
expectedBenefit: Pitru dosh se mukti, parivar mein vikas, santan sukh.
precautions: Tarpan ka jal Tulsi ya pairon ke niche na aaye.
Bina nahaaye na karein.

title: सरल वास्तु सुधार
description: Bina tod-phod ke ghar ka Vastu dosh theek karne aur sakaratmak urja pravahit karne ke asan upay.
itemsNeeded: Samudri Namak (Sea Salt) / Sendha Namak (Rock Salt)
steps: Ghar mein pocha (mopping) lagate samay paani mein thoda samudri namak ya sendha namak zarur milayein.
Ghar ke bathroom aur konon (corners) mein mitti ke kasore mein kacha namak ya fitkari bhar kar rakhein.
Har 15 din mein is namak ko flush kar dein aur naya namak rakh dein.
Ghar ke main gate par haldi aur kumkum se Swastik ka chinha banayein.
Uttaran-Purva (North-East / Ishan kon) disha ko hamesha saaf aur bhari samano se mukt rakhein.
Shaam ko us disha mein diya jalayein ya prakash rakhein.
bestTime: Any time (Pocha lagate samay, Saturday is best for salt changes)
expectedBenefit: Vastu dosh ka nivaaran, parivar mein kalesh kam hona, dhanaagam mein sudhaar.
precautions: Namak ko khule hathon se na chhuein (negative energy absorb karta hai).
Khabhi bhi namak andhere ya gandi jagah par khula na chodein.

title: प्रातः आरती विधि
description: Ghar ke mandir mein sabhi devi-devtaon ka aavahan aur pratah kal ki pavitra shuruaat karne ke liye niyamit aarti.
steps: Puja ki safai karke, sabhi devtaon ko naya jal arpit karein aur phool chadhayein.
Thali mein kapur aur diya jalayein.
Apne Isht Dev ya ghar ke mukhya devta ki aarti gaa kar shuru karein (jaise 'Om Jai Jagdish Hare' ya 'Jai Ganesh Deva').
Aarti thali ko ghadi ki disha (clockwise) mein gol ghumayein. Ek hath se ghanti (bell) lagatar bajate rahein.
Pura hone par aarti par thoda jal ghumakar zameen par chodein (shuddhikaran).
Aarti svayam lein aur pure parivar ko dein, uske baad prasad vitrit karein.
expectedBenefit: Ghar mein bhakti ka mahol, din bhar ke liye sakaratmakta, man ki khushi.
precautions: Aarti thali zameen par bina aasan (plate) ke na rakhein.
Baasi phool hata kar hi nai aarti shuru karein.

title: संध्या वंदन
description: Din aur raat ke milan kaal (sandhya) mein ki jane wali prarthana, jo atmik bal aur shanti badhati hai.
steps: Suryast (Sunset) ke samay hath-pair dho kar saaf kapde pehne.
Ghar ke aangan ya puja sthal par asan bicha kar baithein.
Jal se 3 baar Achaman karein: 'Om Keshavaya Namah, Om Narayanaya Namah, Om Madhavaya Namah'.
Pranayama karein aur apni saanson par dhyan kendrit karein.
Ghee ka deepak jalayein aur Gayatri Mantra ka 108 baar (kam se kam 24 baar) jaap karein.
Ant mein Surya ya Sandhya Devata ko arghya pradan karein aur shanti paath karein.
bestTime: Sandhya kaal (Suryast ke theek 15 min pehle aur baad)
expectedBenefit: Atmabala (inner strength), paapon ka nash, mansik ekagrata.
precautions: Sandhya kaal mein sona, khana ya jhagda nahi karna chahiye.
Pavitrata maintain karein.

title: सत्यनारायण कथा (संक्षिप्त घर की विधि)
description: Ghar mein sukh-shanti aur parivarik samriddhi ke liye bhagwan Satyanarayan ki saral katha aur puja.
itemsNeeded: Panchamrit (Doodh, dahi, ghee, shahad, chini), Tulsi dal
steps: Purnima ya kisi shubh din ghar ke sankalp anusar puja ka sthan saaf karein.
Chowki par peela kapda bichakar Satyanarayan Bhagwan (Vishnu ji) ki murti/photo sthapit karein.
Ganesh ji ki puja se shuruaat karein, fir Vishnu ji ka aavahan karein.
Parivar sahit baithkar Satyanarayan katha ke 5 adhyay shraddha se padhein ya sunein.
Katha samapti par Panjiri aur Panchamrit (jisme Tulsi dal ho) ka bhog lagayein.
Aarti karein aur aaspas ke logo ko prasad baantein.
bestTime: Purnima (Full Moon) ya kisi bhi vrat ke din shaam ko
expectedBenefit: Parivar mein ekta, sukh-smridhi, aur kashton ka nivaran.
precautions: Katha beech mein chhod kar na uthein.
Prasad mein Tulsi dal dalna anivarya (mandatory) hai.

title: सरल गणेश पूजा
description: Koi bhi naya kaam shuru karne se pehle, ya vidyarthi ko padhai mein labh ke liye Ganpati ji ki saral puja.
steps: Snaan karke swachh asan par baithein.
Sabse pehle Ganesh ji ka dhyan karein: 'Vakratunda Mahakaya...'.
Ganesh ji ko jal arpit karein, fir sindoor ka tilak lagayein.
3 ya 5 Durva ghas unke charno ya mathe par chadayein.
'Om Gam Ganapataye Namah' mantra ka 108 baar jaap karein.
Modak ya gud ka bhog lagayein aur aarti sampann karein.
bestTime: Subah (Morning), visheshkar Budhwar (Wednesday) ya Chaturthi ko
expectedBenefit: Vighna badhaon ka nash, safalta, aur gyan ki prapti.
precautions: Ganesh ji ko Tulsi dal nahi chadhana chahiye.
Murti ko dakshin (South) disha ki or mukh karke na rakhein.

title: दुर्गा चालीसा पाठ
description: Maa Durga ki kripa, sahas, aur har tarah ke bhay aur daridrata ko door karne ka shaktishali upay.
steps: Navratri, Shukrawar ya kisi bhi din subah jaldi naha kar lal asan par baithein.
Maa Durga ke samne ghee ka deepak jalayein.
Maa ko lal pushp aur thoda sindoor arpit karein.
Bhagwati ka dhyan karte hue Durga Chalisa ka shuddh uchharan ke sath paath karein.
Paath poora hone par maa se apraadh kshama prarthana karein.
Lal peda, halwa ya mishri ka bhog lagayein.
expectedBenefit: Aatmavishwas (Confidence), shatruo se mukti, nakaratmak shaktiyo ka naash.
precautions: Paath karte samay bich mein kisi se baat na karein.
Pavitrata ka dhyan rakhein.

title: ॐ (ओम) उच्चारण ध्यान
description: Mansik tanav (Stress) aur anxiety ko door karne ke liye sadiyon purana aur scientific tarika.
steps: Subah ya shaam kisi bhi shant kone mein Sukhasana ya Padmasana mein baithein.
Apni peeth (Spine) aur gardan seedhi rakhein. Aankhein halke se band karein.
Gahri saans lein (Deep inhale).
Saans chhodte hue dhvani (sound) karein 'Oooo....Mmmm'. 'O' naabhi se shuru karein aur 'M' hontho (lips) par khatam karein.
Mantra khatam hone ke baad jo vibration (tarang) utpann ho us par dhyan dein.
10-15 minute tak ise lagatar karein aur ant mein dono hath ragad kar aankhon par lagayein.
bestTime: Brahma Muhurta (Early morning) ya sone se pehle (Before sleep)
expectedBenefit: Stress aur anxiety door hoti hai, concentration badhta hai, blood pressure control hota hai.
precautions: Pet bhara nahi hona chahiye.
Jor-jor se chilla kar na gaayein, aawaz sthir aur laya mein ho.

title: श्री यंत्र स्थापना एवं पूजा
description: Ghar aur vyapar mein aarthik unnati aur daridrata nash ke liye Shri Yantra ki saral puja vidhi.
itemsNeeded: Sphatik ya Tambe (Copper) ka Shri Yantra
steps: Shukrawar ko puja sthan par lal kapda bicha kar Shri Yantra sthapit karein.
Sabse pehle yantra ka jal, aur fir panchamrit se abhishek (snan) karein.
Fir se gangajal se dho kar saaf kapde se ponche.
Kumkum ka tilak lagayein, lal phool chadhayein aur dhoop-deep dikhayein.
Kamal Gatte ki mala par 'Om Shreem Hreem Shreem Kamale Kamalalaye Praseed Praseed Shreem Hreem Shreem Om Mahalaxmyai Namah' ka jaap karein (Kam se kam 1 mala).
Kheer ya mewe (dry fruits) ka bhog lagayein.
expectedBenefit: Dhan-dhanya mein achanak vriddhi, band vyapar chal padna, ashtalakshmi ki prapti.
precautions: Yantra ka bindu (center tip) humesha upar ya aapki taraf hona chahiye.
Puja mein aniyamitta (irregularity) na rakhein.

title: कपूर आरती
description: Kapur jalane se vatavaran ke bacteria aur negative energy turant khatam hoti hai. Ye ek bahut quick cleansing technique hai.
itemsNeeded: Aarti Thali ya mitti ka diya
steps: Sham ke samay puja karne ke baad, aarti thali mein 2-3 tukde kapur ke rakhein.
Kapur jalayein aur ghar ke mandir mein aarti karein.
Iske baad jalta hua kapur lekar ghar ke sabhi kamron, rasoi (kitchen), aur konon mein ghumayein.
Dhyan rakhein ki dhua har kone tak pahuche, visheshkar andheri jagaho par.
Ant mein ise main gate (mukhya dwar) par rakh dein.
Aap chahein toh kapur ke sath do laung (cloves) bhi jala sakte hain, jo aur shubh mana jata hai.
expectedBenefit: Microbes (kitanu) ka nash, ghar mein khushbu, neend aachi aana, nakaratmakta kam hona.
precautions: Aag ko kapdo ya jwalanshil (flammable) chizo se dur rakhein.
Dhuye se kisi ko pareshani ho to matra kam karein.

title: काले तिल और जल का उपाय
description: Ghar mein akaran kalah, bimaari ya Pitru Dosh hone par kiya jane wala sabse prabhavshali aur saral totka/upay.
itemsNeeded: Shivling (Ghar ke ya mandir ke paas)
steps: Shanivar ya Amavasya ki subah jaldi uthein.
Snaan ke baad ek lote mein shuddh jal bharein aur usme 1 chammach kale til daalein.
Ghar ke mandir mein ya nazdiki Shiv mandir jaayein.
Dakshin (South) disha ki or mukh karke (ya Shivling par) jal aur til ek dhara (stream) mein arpit karein.
Jal arpit karte hue 'Om Namah Shivaya' aur apne pitruo ka dhyan karein.
Prarthana karein ki parivar ke kasht aur galti maaf ho.
expectedBenefit: Pariwar mein ekta, ruke hue karya poore hona, Pitru aur Shani dosh ki shanti.
precautions: Kale til zameen par bikhre hue na chodein.
Is jal ko Tulsi mein kabhi na daalein.

title: नीम के पत्ते का तोरण
description: Mausam badalne par bimariyo aur buri urja ko ghar ke bahar hi rokne ka paramparik upay. Vasant ritu aur barish mein vishesh upyogi.
itemsNeeded: Tazi Neem ki pattiya (Fresh Neem leaves branches)
steps: Kisi shubh din, visheshkar Chaitra Navratri ya Ugadi/Gudi Padwa ke aaspaas tazi neem ki dali (branches) todein.
Neem ki pattiyo ko dho kar saaf karein.
Mouli (lal dhaga) ka upyog karke pattiyo ki ek ladi (garland/toran) banayein.
Aap isme 7 ya 11 pattiya Aam (Mango) ki bhi mila sakte hain.
Is toran ko ghar ke main gate (mukhya dwar) ke bahar bandh dein.
Jab pattiya puri tarah sukh jayein (lagbhag 7-10 din baad), to unhe nikal kar mitti ya kisi ped ke niche daba dein aur naya laga dein.
bestTime: Subah (Morning), kisi bhi shubh tithi par
expectedBenefit: Hawa se failne wali bimariyo ka bachav, vastu sudhar, ghar ki suraksha.
precautions: Sookhi pattiyo ko jalayein nahi, visarjit karein.
Raat ke samay ped se pattiya na todein.
